description.default: Client script: record voice input transcribed by a local Whisper service and read AI replies aloud with the system TTS. Must be used together with the "Local Speech Service" panel plugin, which starts/stops the local service and manages models.
description.zh-CN: 客户端脚本：语音输入（本机 Whisper 转写）+ AI 回复朗读（系统 TTS）。需与「本地语音服务」面板插件配合使用：由面板一键启停本地转写服务、管理识别模型，本脚本本身不含模型。
